tasks.subject: Task 3: Replace the slide-toggles with filter tiles on the page
tasks.description:
**Goal:** props dashboard page shows a row of 4 tiles (Total, Overridden, Redundant, Overdue) above the name-filter/Add-override toolbar, styled like maia-elasticsearch's status tiles. 3 filter tiles are clickable buttons showing count + active state; old mat-slide-toggle controls/imports removed.

**Files:**
- Modify: projects/maia-props/src/lib/props-dashboard/props-dashboard-page.ts
- Modify: projects/maia-props/src/lib/props-dashboard/props-dashboard-page.html
- Modify: projects/maia-props/src/lib/props-dashboard/props-dashboard-page.scss

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- MatSlideToggleModule/MatSlideToggleChange no longer imported/referenced
- 3 parameterless click handlers flip store booleans via !store.xOnly()
- template has .props-filter-tiles row: non-clickable Total tile (X of Y, aria-live) + 3 clickable button tiles with count/active/aria-pressed
- .props-dashboard-toolbar row now has only name filter + Add override button
- .props-filter-tile* scss copied from elastic-indices-page.scss's .status-tile* rules (no color dot)
- old .props-dashboard-count rule removed
- manually verified or thoroughly self-reviewed
